main_text.head: LIBR. 2. INSTIT. TIT. 23.
De Fideicomm. hared. & Sc. Trebell.
In Princ.
main_text.l: 1. Differentia varia inter directam & fideicommissariam hereditatem.
2. Rogati per salutem Principis implere fideicommissa.
4. Fideicommissa cum tempore utilia esse caperunt.
1. Fideicommissum ab eo relinquitur, qui testamentum facere potest.
4. Non semper heres quarta contentus est.

p.i: Fideicommissarius partialis heredem pro parte cogere potest.

main_text.l: 3. Quid si sint liberi primi gradus?
4. Liberi de moribus duas quartas detra-hunt.
5. An eo casu legitima sit aucta?

page.notes: Right column, from "§. 4.": 1. Quid cautum Trebelliano? 2. Quae actiones non transeant in fideicommissarium? 3. An fructus restituendi? 4. (line cut off). The continuation of the page is cut off at the bottom right; the right column's last line is incomplete and is not transcribed here beyond what is visible. Printed text is set in a narrow column; the left edge carries a faint fragment of a previous column, not transcribed. Doubtful: "aucta" final letter; "Fideicommissa qui probentur" may read "quo".
